raw_response:
This is my small rice plot down in the dambo, just 0.16 hectares. The fertilizer coupons I get from FISP I save for my maize plots — that is what feeds the family, so the rice does not get any chemical fertilizer this year. I use seed I kept from last harvest, and I rely on the wetland soil and a bit of manure I spread before planting. Rice takes a lot of work — preparing the bunds, the nursery, transplanting, weeding two times, then harvesting and threshing — so I will be in this plot many days myself, and ask a few neighbors to help with transplanting.
